items.title: Ten departments issue the "15th Five-Year Plan for Promoting the Development of Small and Medium Enterprises"
items.title_zh: 十部门印发《促进中小企业发展“十五五”规划》
items.summary: To keep advancing high-quality development of SMEs, the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, together with the NDRC, the Ministry of Science and Technology, the Ministry of Finance, the Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security, the Ministry of Commerce, the People's Bank of China, the State Administration for Market Regulation, the financial regulator and the CSRC - ten departments in all - recently jointly issued the "15th Five-Year Plan for Promoting the Development of Small and Medium Enterprises" (the "Plan")
items.summary_zh: 为持续推动中小企业高质量发展，工业和信息化部会同国家发展改革委、科技部、财政部、人力资源和社会保障部、商务部、中国人民 银行 、市场监管总局、金融监管总局、中国证监会共十部门近日联合印发《促进中小企业发展“十五五”规划》（以下简称《规划》）

items.title: The new world of physical AI: from "generating the world" to "controlling the world" - how will the industry chain reshape a RMB300B market?
items.title_zh: 物理AI新世界：从"生成世界"到"控制世界" ，产业链如何重构3000亿市场？
items.summary: How much incremental change does physical AI bring to the industry chain? It maps the technical inflection point of world models from "generating the world" to "controlling the world" (four capability layers, five technical routes, three-stage evolution, six constraints), quantifies the industrial base (542,000 new industrial robots installed globally in 2024, 4.664mn in operation, China accounting for 54% of new installs), breaks down profit distribution across six value-chain layers, and covers autonomous operation of process industries, physical simulation and engineering world models, industrial agents and more
items.summary_zh: 物理AI给产业链带来多少变化增量？ 梳理世界模型从"生成世界"到"控制世界"的技术拐点（四层能力、五条技术路线、三阶段演进、六大约束），量化了产业底座（2024年全球新增工业机器人54.2万台、在役466.4万台、中国占新增54%），拆解了六层价值链的利润分布，并沿流程工业自主运行、物理仿真与工程世界模型、工业智能体与
